audited_against.method: live tree reads via GitHub connector plus byte-level analysis of the downloaded binary; git blob SHA recomputed from the downloaded bytes matches the live tree blob

gates_not_proven_here.final_apk_binary_inclusion: NOT_PROVEN - requires a G2 candidate APK build and inspection of the assembled artifact

restrictions: no commercial game/Windows media in repo
no claims of Win95 or Shandalar gameplay
audit is read-only against the shipped binary; it does not import, replace or rebuild the core

shipped_dosbox_pure._note: Git blob SHA is NOT SHA256; both are recorded here and both are checked by verify_pcr02.py.
shipped_dosbox_pure._provenance_note: The submodule checks in a prebuilt binary. No upstream version or revision string is embedded in the binary and LemuroidCores records no upstream commit for it, so the exact corresponding upstream source revision cannot be pinned from available sources. GPL corresponding-source handling for distribution is governed separately by REL-ENG-01 #307 (see pc04_sources.json distribution_contract).
